channel.title: AdvisoryOps Community Feed
channel.description: Top-scored healthcare cybersecurity and device-safety advisories

item.title: CVE-2008-0015
item.description: Microsoft has identified a critical vulnerability in the Active Template Library that affects multiple versions of Windows, allowing remote attackers to execute unauthorized code. A patch is not available for this issue, so it's crucial to limit exposure by disabling the affected ActiveX control if it is not essential for operations. Further steps should be taken to monitor and protect affected systems from potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2020-7796
item.description: Synacor's Zimbra Collaboration Suite has a critical vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to internal services if the WebEx feature is enabled. A patch is available for versions prior to 8.8.15 Patch 7. It's recommended to update your software to mitigate potential security risks.

item.title: CVE-2024-7694
item.description: TeamT5's ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware has a critical vulnerability that allows remote attackers with admin access to upload harmful files. These files could enable them to execute unauthorized commands on the server. It is essential to immediately assess your environment for this risk and apply any available patches to protect your systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-2441
item.description: Google Chrome versions prior to 145.0.7632.75 have a high-severity vulnerability that allows attackers to run harmful code through a malicious webpage. It's crucial to update your browser to the latest version to protect against this risk. Please ensure all devices using Chrome are fully updated as soon as possible.

item.title: CVE-2018-14634
item.description: The Linux kernel has a critical vulnerability that may allow an unprivileged user to gain higher access privileges on the system. A patch is not explicitly mentioned. It is recommended to review systems using kernel versions 2.6.x, 3.10.x, and 4.14.x and apply any available security updates or mitigations to prevent exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2021-22054
item.description: Omnissa's VMware Workspace ONE UEM has a critical security flaw that allows attackers with network access to potentially access sensitive information without authentication. A patch is available for versions 20.0.8.37, 20.11.0.40, 21.2.0.27, and 21.5.0.37. It is crucial to update your software to the latest version immediately to protect sensitive data.

item.title: CVE-2022-20775
item.description: Cisco SD-WAN Software has a critical vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to gain unauthorized access and execute commands as an administrator. Cisco has released a patch to fix this issue, so it is essential to update the software immediately. Failure to apply the patch may leave the system open to attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-26399
item.description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk has a critical vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute commands on the server without authentication. A patch for this issue is available, so it's essential to update the software immediately to protect against potential attacks. Please ensure your systems are updated accordingly.

item.title: CVE-2025-52691
item.description: SmarterTools has a critical vulnerability that allows unauthorized users to upload files to the mail server, which could lead to serious security issues, including remote code execution. There is currently no information on whether a patch is available. It is recommended to monitor your mail server closely and implement additional security measures until a fix is released.

item.title: CVE-2025-59718
item.description: Fortinet has reported a critical vulnerability in its FortiOS and FortiProxy products that allows unauthorized access by bypassing important login protections. A patch is available, and it's crucial to update your systems immediately to prevent potential attacks. Please prioritize this update to safeguard hospital network security.

item.title: CVE-2025-59719
item.description: Fortinet's FortiWeb product has a critical vulnerability that could allow an attacker to bypass login security features. A patch is available for this issue. It's essential to update affected FortiWeb versions as soon as possible to secure your network.

item.title: CVE-2026-1603
item.description: Ivanti Endpoint Manager has a critical authentication flaw that can let attackers access sensitive stored credentials without needing to log in. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is strongly recommended to update your systems to the latest version immediately to protect against potential breaches.

item.title: CVE-2026-20127
item.description: Cisco has identified a critical vulnerability in its Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and SD-WAN Manager that may allow remote attackers to bypass security and gain administrative access. A patch is available, so it is essential to update your systems immediately to prevent unauthorized access to your network configurations. Please prioritize applying this update to ensure the security of your hospital's network.

item.title: CVE-2026-21509
item.description: Microsoft Office has a critical vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized user to bypass important security features. A patch is available, so it is crucial to update your Microsoft Office applications immediately to protect against this risk. Take action now to ensure all systems are secure.

item.title: CVE-2026-23760
item.description: SmarterTools has identified a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in SmarterMail versions prior to build 9511, allowing unauthorized users to reset administrator passwords and gain full control of the system. A patch is available, and it is highly recommended to update to the latest build immediately to protect sensitive information and system integrity. Failure to update could expose significant security risks to your network.

item.title: CVE-2026-24061
item.description: GNU Inetutils version 2.7 and earlier has a critical vulnerability that allows remote users to bypass authentication. A patch is available. It's important to update your systems immediately to prevent unauthorized access.

item.title: CVE-2025-55182
item.description: Meta's React Server Components have a critical vulnerability that allows unauthorized remote code execution in specific versions 19.0.0 to 19.2.0. There is no current patch available to fix this issue. It is recommended to immediately assess your systems for these versions and either upgrade to a secure version or disable the affected components until a remedy is found.

item.title: Vercel Next.js Advisory (CVE-2025-66478)
item.description: The advisory from Meta indicates that the reported vulnerability in Next.js is a duplicate and does not require further action. No new risks or patches are being introduced from this advisory. Please continue monitoring for other relevant security updates.

item.title: CVE-2025-21042
item.description: Samsung's libimagecodec.quram.so has a critical out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to run harmful code. A patch is available in the SMR Apr-2025 Release 1. It is important to update your systems as soon as possible to mitigate this risk.

item.title: CVE-2025-21043
item.description: Samsung has identified a critical vulnerability in their libimagecodec.quram.so that could allow remote attackers to run any code on affected devices. A patch is expected to be released in September 2025. It is crucial to monitor your devices and apply the patch as soon as it becomes available to protect against potential exploits.

item.title: CVE-2025-27038
item.description: Qualcomm has identified a critical memory corruption vulnerability in the Adreno GPU drivers used in Chrome that could affect system performance. A patch is expected to be made available soon. It is recommended to monitor for updates and apply the patch as soon as it is released.

item.title: CVE-2025-38352
item.description: A critical vulnerability was found in the Linux kernel related to how it handles CPU timers for tasks. A patch is available, and it's recommended to update to the latest version to address this issue and prevent potential exploitation. Make sure to review and apply the patch as soon as possible to ensure system security.

item.title: CVE-2025-40602
item.description: SonicWall's SMA1000 appliance has a serious security flaw that allows unauthorized local access to its management console. This vulnerability is rated as Critical and no patch is currently available. It's crucial to limit access to this device until a fix is provided.

item.title: CVE-2025-43300
item.description: Apple has identified a critical vulnerability in their devices that can lead to memory corruption when processing malicious image files. A patch is available in the latest versions of iOS and iPadOS. It is essential for hospital security teams to update affected devices promptly to mitigate potential risks.

item.title: CVE-2025-48543
item.description: Android devices have a critical vulnerability that could allow attackers to gain higher privileges without user interaction. A patch is available, and it is crucial to apply this update promptly to protect the hospital's Android systems. Ignoring this issue could expose the network to serious risks.

item.title: CVE-2025-61884
item.description: Oracle's E-Business Suite has a critical vulnerability in the Configurator product, affecting versions 12.2.3 to 12.2.14. This flaw allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive data through the internet, and a patch is available. We recommend updating to the latest version immediately to protect your systems from potential data breaches.

item.title: CVE-2025-5419
item.description: A high-severity vulnerability in Google Chrome allows attackers to corrupt memory data through a malicious HTML page. It is crucial to update Chrome to version 137.0.7151.68 or later, as a patch is available. Please ensure that all Chrome installations in the hospital are updated promptly to protect patient data and hospital systems.

item.title: CVE-2025-6558
item.description: Google Chrome versions before 138.0.7204.157 have a high-severity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to escape security measures when visiting malicious web pages. A patch is available, so it is critical to update Chrome to the latest version immediately to protect against this issue. Please ensure all browsers are updated in your network to minimize risks.

item.title: CVE-2025-15556
item.description: Notepad++ versions before 8.8.9 have a critical vulnerability in their update process, which could allow an attacker to install harmful software unknowingly. A patch is available to fix this issue. It's essential to update to the latest version immediately to protect against potential code execution risks.

item.title: CVE-2025-40536
item.description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk has a critical vulnerability that could allow unauthorized users to access restricted features. A patch is available. It is crucial to apply the patch immediately to protect your systems from potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-47813
item.description: Wing FTP Server, versions prior to 7.4.4, has a vulnerability that can expose sensitive information about its installation path when a long UID cookie is used. This is rated as Critical, and a patch is available. It is recommended to update to the latest version as soon as possible to secure your system.

item.title: CVE-2024-43468
item.description: Microsoft's Configuration Manager has a critical remote code execution vulnerability. A patch is available, and it is highly recommended that you update to fix this issue. Take immediate action to ensure your systems are secured.

item.title: CVE-2019-6693
item.description: Fortinet's FortiOS has a critical vulnerability that uses a hard-coded cryptographic key in backup files, which could allow an attacker to access sensitive information such as user passwords and private key passphrases. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is strongly recommended that you update your FortiOS software as soon as possible to protect sensitive data.

item.title: CVE-2025-14174
item.description: Google Chrome on Mac has a high-severity vulnerability that allows attackers to access restricted memory through a malicious HTML page. A patch is available, so it is essential to update Chrome to the latest version immediately to protect your systems. Ensure all users are informed and assist them with the update process.

item.title: CVE-2025-31277
item.description: Apple has reported a critical vulnerability in their products where malicious web content could cause memory corruption. A patch is available in the latest versions of Safari, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and other related systems. It is recommended to update all affected devices immediately to protect against potential exploits.

item.title: CVE-2025-43510
item.description: Apple has fixed a critical memory corruption vulnerability in multiple products, including iOS and macOS, which could allow malicious apps to interfere with system memory. Patches are available for the affected versions. It's essential to update your devices to the latest versions to mitigate this risk.

item.title: CVE-2025-43520
item.description: Apple has fixed a critical memory corruption vulnerability in multiple products, including iOS and macOS versions. A patch is available, and it's essential to update to the latest versions to prevent potential system crashes from malicious applications. Please ensure all affected Apple devices are updated promptly.

item.title: CVE-2025-43529
item.description: Apple has addressed a critical vulnerability in its devices that could allow attackers to execute harmful code through malicious web content. A patch is available for watchOS, Safari, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS versions 26.2 and above. We recommend updating all affected devices to the latest versions immediately to protect against potential exploitation.

item.title: Amaranth-Dragon: Weaponizing CVE-2025-8088 for Targeted Espionage in the Southeast Asia
item.description: RARLAB's WinRAR for Windows has a critical path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers to run harmful code through specially crafted archive files. A patch is available to address this issue. It is strongly recommended to update WinRAR immediately to prevent potential exploits.

item.title: CVE-2026-20700
item.description: Apple has identified a critical memory corruption vulnerability in iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS that could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code. A patch has been released in version 26.3 for all affected devices, so it's essential to update as soon as possible to protect against potential exploits. Please ensure all devices are upgraded to the latest version to mitigate this risk.

item.title: CVE-2025-53770
item.description: Microsoft SharePoint Server has a critical vulnerability that allows attackers to execute unauthorized code over the network. A patch is being prepared, but until it's available, it's crucial to implement the recommended mitigation steps to protect your system. Please make sure these security measures are in place to prevent exploitation.

item.title: Microsoft SharePoint Advisory (CVE-2025-53770 & CVE-2025-53771)
item.description: Microsoft Office SharePoint has a critical security flaw that allows unauthorized individuals to impersonate legitimate users over a network. A patch is available, and it is strongly recommended to apply this update immediately to protect patient data and hospital operations.

item.title: CVE-2025-61882
item.description: Oracle has identified a critical vulnerability in their Concurrent Processing component of the E-Business Suite that affects versions 12.2.3 to 12.2.14. This flaw allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access remotely, potentially taking control of the system. It is crucial to immediately update to the latest version or apply available patches to mitigate this risk.

item.title: CVE-2017-7921
item.description: Hikvision's camera devices have a serious authentication vulnerability that could allow unauthorized users to gain access and escalate their privileges. This is rated as Critical, and a patch is available. It is recommended to update all affected devices to secure your systems against potential threats.

item.title: CVE-2019-19006
item.description: Sangoma FreePBX versions 115.0.16.26 and below, 14.0.13.11 and below, and 13.0.197.13 and below have a critical access control vulnerability. A patch is not mentioned in the available information. It is recommended to upgrade to a secure version immediately to protect the system from unauthorized access.

item.title: CVE-2021-22175
item.description: GitLab has a critical server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthorized access, affecting all versions from 10.5 onwards. There is currently no patch available. It is recommended to disable webhook requests to enhance security while waiting for a fix.

item.title: CVE-2021-22681
item.description: Rockwell Automation's Studio 5000 Logix Designer and RSLogix 5000 have a vulnerability that could allow unauthorized users to authenticate with several Logix controllers. This is rated as Critical, and a patch is available. It is recommended to apply the patch immediately to protect your systems from potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2021-39935
item.description: GitLab has a critical vulnerability that allows unauthorized users to make requests to the server, impacting multiple versions. A patch is available for affected versions, and it’s crucial to update your software immediately to protect against potential exploits. Ensure your system is running a version that includes the latest security fix.

item.title: CVE-2024-37079
item.description: Broadcom's vCenter Server has a critical heap-overflow vulnerability that could allow an attacker with network access to execute malicious code remotely. A patch is currently available to fix this issue. It is recommended to update your vCenter Server immediately to protect against potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-11953
item.description: The React Native Community's Metro Development Server has a critical vulnerability that allows attackers to execute unauthorized commands remotely. A patch is not currently available, so it is crucial to restrict access to the server and monitor for any suspicious activity. Ensure that the server is not exposed to untrusted networks to minimize risk.
